illusion_ground_truth — GENERATIVE illusion op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.illusion_ground_truth(name: 'str' = '') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import illusion; illusion.illusion_ground_truth(name: 'str' = '') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsgenerative.get("illusion_ground_truth"))

Usage

Returns, as a table, the exact invariants that the illusions preserve (empty name gives all of them).

★This is the core of the family. Hand out just the figure and it ends with "how pretty", but when the ground truth comes out together with the figure, you can score the side that measures. Every value in the return value is "the value it should be", not a measured value (measuring is the caller's job).
